primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to week 48 in liver stiffness assessed by magnetic resonance elastography.
efficacy_outcome: Liver stiffness did not differ significantly from placebo at week 48 (estimated treatment ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.89–1.03; P=0.2798). Liver steatosis reductions were greater with semaglutide at weeks 24, 48, and 72 (estimated treatment ratios 0.70, 0.47, and 0.50; all P≤0.0002).
